Country.evidence_source: The present study is based on a subsample from an ongoing psychological autopsy study (PA-study) carried out at Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Dieserud, 2006).

Population.evidence_source: The PA-approach (Shneidman, 1993) utilized in the main study comprises in-depth interviews with significant people surrounding each case of suicide.

Type.evidence_source: The present study is based on a subsample from an ongoing psychological autopsy study (PA-study) carried out at Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Dieserud, 2006).

Area.evidence_source: The aim was to provide detailed and explanatory information about the interplay between psychological mechanisms, social contexts, and life events in the suicidal process.
